svg.title: JKY Terminal themes, live
svg.desc: One JKY Terminal window cycling through its seven built-in themes — Cyberpunk, Dracula, Nord, Solarized, Light, Gold and High Contrast. Every colour is a design token, so the whole window changes together. A meter shows each theme's measured text-on-ground contrast ratio.
svg.text: Seven themes. One set of tokens.
every colour below is a token — the whole window changes together, never piece by piece

g.text: theme High Contrast · text on ground 21.0:1
default · dark · neon is earned, not ambient
light · warm parchment, amber to bronze
WCAG AAA · loud borders, no shadows

svg.text: or type jky theme <name> in any terminal
